intro: Laos has about 7.6 million people and 50 officially recognised ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: The Lao are the largest group; the Khmu and Hmong are large minorities. Lao is closely related to Thai. Most people are Buddhist, and monks collect alms each morning in Luang Prabang.
Most people live in the countryside and grow sticky rice.

chapters.title: Vientiane
text: Vientiane, the capital, is one of the quietest capitals in Asia.

keyTerms.meaning: Food or gifts given to monks.
